1. It recorded MessageTranscript as the only consumer. There were three importers: MessageTranscript, reasoning (live, reached via MessagePart, so inside the typecheck program) and the dead plan. Reasoning was repointed at the owned component; plan was deleted.

Props are duration (seconds) and spread (px per character), the same API as before.
